chunks: 885 - Zurarah narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:

Indeed, the minimum of the adhan that suffices is that he begin the night with an adhan and iqamah, and begin the day with an adhan and iqamah; and for the rest of the salat, an iqamah without an adhan suffices for you.

key_terms.أَدْنَى: the minimum or least amount that is sufficient
key_terms.إِقَامَةٍ: the call immediately preceding the commencement of salat
key_terms.اللَّيْلَ: the night, referring here to the beginning night prayer period
key_terms.النَّهَارَ: the day, referring here to the beginning daytime prayer period
key_terms.يُجْزِي: suffices or fulfills the required minimum

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum amount of adhan and iqamah that suffices for the daily prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith states the minimum sufficient practice regarding the adhan and iqamah for the daily prayers. It indicates that beginning the night and the day with both adhan and iqamah is sufficient, while for the remaining prayers, iqamah alone suffices.
